tasks.label: Stop upload server :4000
args: $pid = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($pid) { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force; Write-Output ("Stopped upload server PID=" + $pid) } else { Write-Output "No process listening on port 4000" }
